audit.why: Emerald+ figure 58.9% over 309 games matches the data.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff is EVEN and diffRating 6/10 on a 58.9% / 309-game lane, and the level chart calls Levels 4-5 and Level 6 "Skill" while giving Aurora the 2+ item stage.
audit.why: Graves top is a range-checked matchup Aurora dominates until he finishes tank-ADC items; the packet chart and the prose (spikes[3], whys[6]: "He out-scales") both put the 2+ item stage on Graves.
audit.corrected: diff FAV, diffRating 4/10; chart becomes Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Graves.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 text calls the ultimate "Between the Worlds" and never names Collateral Damage; the 2+ item spike is not tied to True Grit stacking.
audit.why: Aurora R is Between Worlds (140/120/100s). Graves R Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s and 1000 range — it is his only ranged burst and the thing Aurora must bait.
audit.corrected: Named the real abilities and tied each spike to a cooldown: Between Worlds at 6, Collateral Damage 100s at rank 1, True Grit stacking at 2 items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction of the matchup is absent everywhere: Graves's passive New Destiny fires 4 bullets that "cannot pass through units".
audit.why: A single minion between Aurora and Graves eats his shotgun, which is why an immobile mage survives a point-blank ADC. Also missing: End of the Line detonates instantly on terrain collision, so hugging a wall makes his Q explode on you early; and Quickdraw's 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown is reduced by his basic attacks, so "it is down" must be counted in autos, not seconds.
audit.corrected: Stated minion-blocking of New Destiny, terrain detonation of End of the Line, and auto-attack cooldown reduction on Quickdraw.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown breakdown gave no numbers at all.
audit.why: Real numbers make the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Quickdraw 16s rank 1 (shortened by autos), Smoke Screen 26s rank 1, Collateral Damage 100s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad read "it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot" — an ungrammatical, unclear line reused in four places.
audit.why: It appears in tradeBad, breakdown.trading, dontsFull[2].d and report[3].t.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to name the hop and the consequence.

edits.before: Q-E weave stacks your passive drain from range. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: New Destiny's 4 bullets cannot pass through units — last-hit behind your minions and his Level 1 burst never lands.

edits.before: The hop makes your poke pattern untouchable. Only take the trade when Graves's Quickdraw is down.
edits.after: The Weirding hops you backward, so your poke is untouchable. Trade when Quickdraw is down — 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Quickdraw's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: End of the Line detonates on terrain: fight in open lane, not the wall. Trade on Quickdraw's cooldown and bank leads.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — fights inside it are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Between Worlds zones the all-in and its teleport dodges Collateral Damage — a 100s shell aimed where you were. Fight inside the rift, never outside it.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Graves carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Tank-ADC items and stacked True Grit flip the point-blank duel. Graves carry threat 8/10 — close before the map does.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Quickdraw (E): 16s at rank 1, but every basic attack he lands cuts it — count his autos, not seconds. - Smoke Screen (W): 26s at rank 1; the nearsight is his disengage. - Collateral Damage (R): 100s — bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Q-E weave stacks your passive drain from range. Respect Graves's Quickdraw completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Q-E weave stacks your passive drain from range. New Destiny cannot shoot through units, so keep a minion between you and bank small advantages instead of proving a point.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack three passive hits on Graves with Q-E weaving, cash the drain, and hop out before his answer lands. Great trade: Graves wastes Quickdraw — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Burning the hop for damage spacing — it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot.
edits.after: Good trade: three passive hits with Q-E weaving from behind the wave, cash the drain, hop out before Quickdraw closes. Great trade: he spends Quickdraw on a minion — commit everything. Bad trade: burning The Weirding's hop for chip damage, leaving you with no escape from his dash.

edits.before: Burning the hop for damage spacing — it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot.
edits.after: Burning The Weirding's hop for chip — it is your answer to Quickdraw, and his dash then reaches you free.

edits.before: - Aurora vs Graves - Track: Graves Quickdraw. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Quickdraw's cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Aurora vs Graves - Keep a minion between you: New Destiny cannot shoot through units. - Track Quickdraw (E), 16s. - His autos shorten it. - Bait Collateral Damage first.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 and his autos shorten it. Count autos, then commit when spent.

edits.before: That is Graves's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The hop is your only answer to Quickdraw — spend it on chip and his dash reaches you.

edits.before: Burning the hop for damage spacing — it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot.
edits.after: Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1. Save it for a kill window or a dodged Collateral Damage, not for spacing.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Spirit-stack burst + hop out.
edits.after: New Destiny fires 4 bullets that cannot pass through units — a minion in the way eats his shotgun. Quickdraw (E) is 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: His two point-blank shotgun autos burst hard up close and you are still a single-target mage with one charge of W to escape — respect his range and last-hit safe at Level 1.
edits.after: New Destiny fires 4 bullets that cannot pass through units, so last-hit from behind your own minions — step into the open and his two-auto point-blank burst chunks you at Level 1.

edits.before: Your poke, spirit sustain, and W cooldown line up so you control spacing before his shotgun pellets ever reach full range.
edits.after: Your poke, spirit sustain and the 15s Weirding control spacing, and your minions swallow the bullets he needs.

edits.before: He out-scales: tank-ADC build plus point-blank shotgun DPS bursts you the moment W is down, so once items land you play safe and let the lead carry.
edits.after: He out-scales: tank-ADC items, stacked True Grit and point-blank shotgun DPS burst you the moment W is down, so play safe once his items land.

edits.before: Drop his W smoke on you to nearsight your spacing and break line of sight when you try to curse-recast
edits.after: Land Smoke Screen (W, 26s) on you to nearsight your spacing and break line of sight when you try to curse-recast

edits.before: Graves' window: tank-ADC build plus point-blank shotgun autos out-DPS your poke, and he can E-dash in and burst you the instant W is down.
edits.after: Graves' window: tank-ADC items and stacked True Grit out-DPS your poke point-blank, and Quickdraw closes the instant W is down.

notes: Full layer wrote Aurora's ultimate as "Between the Worlds" (real name: Between Worlds) and never named a single Graves ability besides Quickdraw. The decisive fact of the lane — New Destiny's 4 bullets cannot pass through units, so minions block his shotgun — was absent from both layers. Level chart flipped to match the 58.9% win rate, the packet chart, and the file's own prose (whys[6] already said Graves out-scales while win[6] said Aurora).
